Augustamnĭca , ae, f. Augustusamnis,
I.a designation, after the time of Diocletian, of the eastern part of Lower Egypt, in which were the cities Pelusium, Rhinocolura, etc., Amm. 22, 16; Cod. Th. 1, 14, 1.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
